name: Merchant
otherNightReminder:
Wake up the Merchant and have them choose 1 or 2. They may only choose 2 if they are, to their knowledge, holding a potion.
  1 - Put a potion on them.
  2 - Have them name a potion they think they hold and another, alive player. If they hold that potion, move it to the chosen player.
ability: Each night*, choose either 1) receive a potion, or if you hold a potion 2) choose a potion you think you are holding and a player (not yourself) to receive that potion.
flavor: I will buy with you, sell with you, talk with you, walk with you, and so following, but I will not eat with you, drink with you, nor pray with you.
